message.content: According to the group discussion, the match against Manchester City in 2022 was particularly notable for its stoppage-time comeback goal. Specifically, JakeWatson shared that the match featured a stoppage-time goal by Rodrygo, which turned the tide of the game in favor of Real Madrid. This goal exemplified the "never-say-die" attitude of Real Madrid, showcasing their resilience and determination to secure victory even in dire circumstances. The match was described as a dramatic and thrilling encounter, highlighting the intensity and unpredictability that characterize games played by the club.
